text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (Thank goodness... Running it gave me the certainty I needed.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (I haven't fallen behind...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Chrono Genesis is doing
pretty well in GⅠ races too, huh!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, she's got great explosive power.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I have returned.

When Chrono Genesis returned,
she wore a bright, radiant expression.
choice_data_list: I think you really left your mark out there on the turf!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
I'm relieved I was able to keep my word... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "...Running a single race in the Twinkle Series is—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: This is easily worth dozens of historical documents...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: It provides a wealth of real-world tangible experience that cannot be understood through knowledge alone...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...The speed demanded in a GⅠ
was on an entirely different level..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"I'd say I have a fair amount of explosive power myself, but...
the speed of Umamusume with high mile aptitude
was simply on another level..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho is also 1,600m, and... Gran-chan is there.

Gran Alegria—
Living up to her self-proclaimed title of mile prodigy,
she displays exceptional running in 1600m races.

She isn't running in the Hanshin JF;
she's scheduled to run in the Asahi Hai FS instead.
For the Oka Sho contenders, the Hanshin JF serves as a chance to gauge each other's strength. Did she consider it unnecessary, though?

She must be that confident
in 1600m races.
choice_data_list: Let's focus on strengthening your speed.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will once again look for countermeasures from historical races... and examine them using the Genesis Method.
And just as we began training for the Oka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What sheer grit! Shrugging off Gran Alegria,
an undefeated Junior-tier champion is born—!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
N-No waaaay!
Why, whyyy!? I totally thought I had it in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuugh, revenge!
I'll definitely get my revenge and take back the Mile throne!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Let's race again in the Mile!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Gran-chan came in third...

I couldn't tell what had affected her.
All I knew was that she hadn't run like her usual self.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Is this... how difficult it really is to win a GⅠ race?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Even the slightest lapse in focus can become the stone that trips you up...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Love-chan, too...
In her last race, her conditioning didn't go quite as planned—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"She accumulated quite a bit of fatigue...
so she had to sit out the Hanshin JF..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho, Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), and Shuka Sho—
races you can only run once in a lifetime...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"However, if we don't leave our hoofprints there,
we won't even be able to forge a new era...!"
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's take it steadily, one race at a time!
Yeah. Let's take it one race at a time, nice and steady!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

One day during lunch break...
I spotted Chrono Genesis acting rather suspiciously.
choice_data_list: Chrono? What are you doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Kya!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: T-T-Trainer-san...! I-It's not what you think, I was just looking at my phone...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah, w-well, from now on...

When she says "later," you have to be careful.
To make sure she doesn't skip lunch,
I decide to invite her to the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Actually... the roster for the Arima Kinen
is about to be announced...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Wait for it—ah!
I-It's here!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Almond Eye-san is passing, Blast-san is running, and then...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Lilie-san's name isn't there...
choice_data_list: Yeah, Chrono is cheering for you...

text_block_list.text:
Schön Lilie—the Umamusume who had suffered
defeats in both the Hanshin Umamusume Stakes
and the Yasuda Kinen in the past.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Still... I placed 13th in the fan vote.
Just that result alone is enough to satisfy me.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Lilie-san's Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "That just shows how many fans were captivated by that historic drama..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Emerging from a long tunnel of defeat...
she finally claimed a GⅠ victory—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Those tears of joy during the winner's interview
must have touched the hearts of so many people...!

Chrono Genesis was no exception.
I remember her showing up to training the next day
with swollen, tear-stained eyes.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix is wonderful, isn't it...?
Our feelings come together to shape the race...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
As a result,
dream races are born from it too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Especially this time, Umamusume whose main battlegrounds
are totally different routes are competing...!

For the Grand Prix races—
the Arima Kinen and Takarazuka Kinen—
fan voting determines who is eligible to run.

Unlike usual races,
she was able to enter thanks to the support of her fans.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the event, of course I'll be there in person...
I'm also looking forward to the pre-events.
choice_data_list: However, you're already one of the people involved, aren't you?
However, you're already one of the people involved, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
There's a chance she might even be chosen for the next Takarazuka Kinen.

I'm not on the side entrusting my hopes through a vote.
I'm the Umamusume who carries the fans' hopes on her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...!
Y-Yeah, that's true...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...I have to give it my all
at the Oka Sho...!"
